outgoing.name: Steel
outgoing.excerpt: The southbound Amtrak train 59, the City of New Orleans, hit a semi truck, loaded with steel, that was blocking a grade crossing.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The accident occurred March 15, 1999, at 9:47pm Central (local) time in Bourbonnais, Illinois, in the United States on the Illinois Central Railroad.

outgoing.name: United States dollar
outgoing.excerpt: The accident resulted in the deaths of 11 of the train's passengers, 122 injuries and over US$14 million in damages.
